evidence: process_statement_upload (accounting.rs:49-107) imports a whole bank statement as independently-autocommitting writes over an RlsConnection (NOT a sqlx Transaction; handler is upload_statement(mut rls: RlsConnection) at routes/accounting/statements.rs:16-17, call at :51). No begin()/commit() on the path: header insert (create_bank_statement_rls, :61-71), per-row line-insert loop (:96-99), matcher (run_payment_matcher, :103) each autocommit separately.

Consequence 1 (partial import): a mid-loop CSV parse error (:74-81 returns AppError::BadRequest) leaves the already-committed header + rows 1..N-1 orphaned as an unmatched half-statement; handler returns 400 but nothing rolls back.

Consequence 2 (double-count on retry): no (tenant_id, filename, content-hash) idempotency key, so re-upload after a partial failure creates a second statement, re-inserts lines, and re-runs the matcher -> duplicate PaymentMatch suggestions / double-applied AR amounts. Money-facing integrity hazard.

Same root-cause CLASS as the 2026-08-14 finding code-review-api-core-accounting-confirm-no-tx (confirm_match/reject_match) but a DISTINCT, unflagged code path (CSV import + matcher). Correct pattern already exists in the module family: routes/accounting/invoices.rs:241 rls.begin() / :269 tx.commit(). Fix: wrap upload_statement in one transaction threaded through header + line loop + matcher, commit once; optionally add the dedup guard. Confidence medium (static read; partial-commit behavior inferred from sqlx autocommit semantics).

accounting.rs:68 always stores the placeholder account IBAN CZ0000000000000000000000 (inline comment says default-if-not-in-CSV, but the CSV account IBAN is never parsed, so the constant is the only value ever stored) for every upload across all tenants.

Effect: every bank_statement row shares an identical meaningless account_iban, defeating audit/reconciliation that keys on which org account a statement belongs to. The matcher keys off per-line counterparty_iban (:90), not this field, so it is a data-traceability/integrity gap, not a matching-correctness bug -> low severity.

Fix: parse the statement account IBAN from the CSV header/first line (normalise via the canonicalisation helper at accounting.rs:17-20) and store the real value; keep the placeholder only as a genuine last-resort fallback. Confidence medium (static read).
